v1: 5-fold publisher-cluster cross-fit on anchors, 20 fold draws
v2: 200 draws; kappa_score in {0,1,2}, delta_label in {0,1}; 60% target fit share
bootstrap: 300 draws; anchor publisher clusters (link refit) x target clusters; seed-averaged
primary_link: flexible score function (linear spline, hinges at anchor quartiles of the logit); chosen because the linear link is misspecified for bimodal transformer logits (diagnosed in V2); both are reported, and V1 gives the cross-fitted anchor NLL of each

private_raw_outputs.note: per-draw rows; summaries in this folder are computed from them
